    We specialize in holistic solutions in the outsourcing field

    Enabling our clients to invest their  company's resources in core business and business development.

    Our services

    With a unique service portfolio, OneXHub's team comprehensively responds to all peripheral business domains of our client's operations.

    With the understanding that companies and organizations operate at their best when becoming core business-oriented, we offer advanced management, recruitment, and remote operations solutions in a one-stop shop. We accompany our clients and business partners with a variety of tailor-made solutions.

    We provide solutions in three main domains:

    Company Management (Human): Negotiates with suppliers, communicates with vendors and handles the company's payment operations.

    ​

    Recruitment, Placement & employment (HR): Employee Recruitment & Placement Services, comprehensive human resources, full workforce solutions, including employee salaries.

    ​

    Operational Services (Technical): Contracts and supplier management, company branch opening and management abroad, and customer payment management.
